help_faqQ1: How does the outfit engine work?
help_faqA1: The engine scores every combination of your wardrobe items against your style profile, body measurements, and current weather. It ranks outfits by colour harmony, proportions, formality, and season — then surfaces the top results in your feed.
help_faqQ2: Why are my outfits not personalised?
help_faqA2: Personalisation requires at least one item in your wardrobe. Add items via the Wardrobe tab and the feed will switch from demo outfits to ones built from your actual clothes.
help_faqQ3: Can I use the app offline?
help_faqA3: Saved outfits, schedules, and outfit history are available offline. Adding new wardrobe items requires an internet connection to sync photos and data to the cloud.
help_faqQ4: How do I delete my account?
help_faqA4: Go to Settings → Danger Zone → Delete Account. This permanently removes your profile, wardrobe, and all associated data. The action cannot be undone.
help_faqQ5: How do I change my body measurements?
help_faqA5: Go to Menu → Size & Measurements. You can update height, weight, and optional measurements at any time. Changes take effect on the next outfit generation.
